errors._comment: Server-error i18n seam (issue #94 / #629): keys match ApiError.code via translateApiError().
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests — please slow down and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: That change conflicted with a newer write.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests — please slow down and try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.STALE_WRITE: Someone else saved changes since you loaded — reload and try again.
errors.CHARACTER_SEAT_TAKEN: That character seat is already taken.
errors.ENCOUNTER_ALREADY_RUNNING: Another encounter is already running for this campaign.
errors.COMBATANT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: That combatant identity is already on the roster.
errors.COMBAT_LOG_ACTOR_DM_ONLY: Only the DM can set who dealt that damage — it is credited to whoever's turn it is.
errors.TURN_END_NEEDS_DM_CONFIRM: Ending this turn needs DM confirmation.
errors.TURN_ALREADY_ADVANCED: Someone else already advanced the turn — resyncing.
errors.HP_SYNC_CONFLICT: Hit points changed on the server — reload and try again.
errors.REOPEN_NO_COMBATANTS: Can't reopen — no combatants on the roster.
errors.INVENTORY_QTY_CONFLICT: Item quantity changed on the server — reload and try again.
errors.TREASURY_CONFLICT: Treasury changed on the server — reload and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE: That action was already applied — reload to see the result.
errors.private_notes_excluded: Private notes were excluded from this export.
errors.attachment_bytes_missing: An attachment is missing its stored bytes.
errors.template_play_state_reset: Play state was reset for this template.
errors.generate_map_budget_exhausted: Map generation budget exhausted for this session.
errors.forbidden_encounter_field: That encounter field can't be changed from here.
errors.forbidden_map_link: That map link can't be changed from here.
errors.forbidden_treasury_field: That treasury field can't be changed from here.
errors.forbidden_treasury_grant_limit: That treasury grant exceeds the limit.
errors.forbidden_inventory_field: That inventory field can't be changed from here.
errors.forbidden_secret_read: That secret can't be read from here.
errors.empty-roster: No creatures selected yet — add or reroll a slot to build the encounter.
errors.unsupported-system: Difficulty math isn't available for this rules system yet.
errors.difficulty-unknown: Difficulty band couldn't be computed for this roster.
errors.missing-statblock: A creature is missing stat block data.
errors.role-duplication: Multiple creatures share the same battlefield role.
errors.action-economy: Action economy looks tight for this party level.
errors.swinginess: This fight may swing hard — consider tuning.
